name: FullContact Person Enrich
purpose: Wrapper around the FullContact v3 person.enrich API: validates the JSON parameter, splits the email and phone lists into JSON arrays, builds a POST request to https://api.fullcontact.com/v3/person.enrich with a Bearer key read from the System record and a body of emails, phones and name (family, given, full), calls "HTTP Native" and returns the response body. Address fields are parsed but not sent (the full-request variant, step 121, is disabled).
writes: System#cartesian::z_xJoin#58 (Set Field step 113, global: join key set to 1 to reach the System record)
external: Perform Script HTTP Native (karbon_kontroller scripts/750, step 126): POST https://api.fullcontact.com/v3/person.enrich
open_question: secret: step 114 reads the FullContact API key from System#cartesian::FullContactAPIKey#76 (a stored field in karbon_data) and step 122 sends it as "Authorization: Bearer"; the disabled step 124 contains a hard-coded bearer token literal (do not copy it; rotate it). The target must keep the key out of code. Step 23 (sample result) is disabled. Script is listed in the Scripts menu (includeInMenu=True).
